page_title: LIL 2-1 REI | Lille v Reims 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Willy Delajod is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+3' Rough tackle by Chuba Akpom (Lille). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Thomas Meunier (Lille) makes a strong challenge and Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
90+1' Benjamin Andre (Lille) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' That's the end of the game for Remy Cabella, who is replaced by Ngalayel Mukau (Lille).
88' Samba Diawara has decided to substitute Valentin Atangana Edoa and he is replaced by Oumar Diakite (Reims).
87' Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
86' 2 - 1 Goal! Chuba Akpom (Lille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yehvann Diouf into the bottom right corner.
84' Joseph Okumu (Reims) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
84' Joseph Okumu (Reims) commits a rough foul. Willy Delajod stops the game and makes a call. Lille are about to take a penalty!
80' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Osame Sahraoui (Lille) will replace Ayyoub Bouaddi.
78' The Reims players are exchanging some short passes.

74' Bafode Diakite (Lille) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
74' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) takes the corner.
73' The substitution is prepared. Chuba Akpom (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jonathan David.
70' It's time for a substitution. John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) comes on in place of Amadou Kone.
70' Substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu did his best and is replaced by Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims).
69' Samba Diawara has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nhoa Sangui (Reims) replacing Junya Ito.
69' Willy Delajod blows his whistle. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) commits a foul after dangerous play.
66' The resulting corner from Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) comes to nothing.
64' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) picks up an injury.
64' Thomas Meunier (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
63' Lille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
60' 1 - 1 Goal! Sergio Akieme (Reims) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the top of the net.
60' The ball is out of play and Reims manage to earn a corner.
59' Buta (Reims) is being substituted because of an injury. Samba Diawara sends Ange Tia on the pitch.
57' Looks like Buta (Reims) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
55' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Buta (Reims) heads on.
52' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
50' Lille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
48' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
48' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Lille can continue in their attacking effort.
47' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is able to continue to play.
46' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Benjamin Andre (Lille) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The ball is cleared after Mory Gbane (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
43' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
42' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
39' Dangerous play by Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille). Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
37' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0. Remy Cabella (Lille) is first to the rebound and finds the back of the net with a brilliant back-heel finish.
37' The corner kick from Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
36' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
33' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf is equal to it and makes an easy save.
33' Neat passing move from Reims in order to create new attacking opportunities.
32' The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
29' Jonathan David (Lille) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
26' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
24' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
22' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
18' Willy Delajod has a clear sight and sees a foul from Buta (Reims).
16' Remy Cabella (Lille) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
15' Willy Delajod blows his whistle as Cedric Kipre (Reims) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
15' Junya Ito (Reims) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
14' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) plays a through ball but overhits it.
12' Lille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
10' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Willy Delajod saw the whole situation. Free kick. Reims will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
8' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the left post.
5' Junya Ito (Reims) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
5' Junya Ito (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Reims will have a corner.
4' The resulting corner from Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is cleared.
2' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Lille will take the kick-off.
Willy Delajod was nominated as the referee for this game.
